paper_metadata.title: Microstructural evolution and mechanical behaviour of Nb–10Hf–15W alloy doped with Si

evidence.quote: The microstructural evolution and mechanical properties of Nb–10Hf–15W–(0/1/3/5)Si (at.-%) alloys were investigated.

attributes.morphology: eutectic microstructure consisting of a bright NbSS phase and a grey Nb3Si phase

evidence.quote: An enlarged image inset in Figure 2(d) clearly shows that these grey phases have a eutectic microstructure consisting of a bright NbSS phase and a grey Nb3Si phase.
The microstructure consists of an NbSS matrix with eutectoid NbSS/α-Nb5Si3 dots (2–7μm in size) and strips (∼5 μm in width) in the 3Si sample (Figure3(c))
and a eutectoid NbSS/α-Nb5Si3 network (5–8μm in width) in the 5Si sample (Figure3(d)).

attributes.morphology: zigzag manner, characterised by large angled turns and deflections over long distances
